caption: The drawing depicts a single bowl, centrally positioned within a lightly outlined rectangular frame. The bowl is wide-mouthed with gently sloping sides and a slightly narrower base. Its coloration is a mix of light brown and tan hues, with subtle darker spots distributed across the surface, giving it a speckled appearance. A decorative border runs just below the rim, consisting of vertical scalloped or looped patterns extending downward. The inner edge of the bowl appears lighter, hinting at possible depth. The background is plain and uncolored, with the object casting a faint shadow below. The artist's signature, "Annie B. Johnston," is located in the lower right corner within the outlined rectangle.
title: Bowl with Ornamented Rim
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
